from .calendar import merge_half_open_windows

    enqueue_wall_ms: int,
    policy: SlaPolicy,
    blackout_windows: Sequence[tuple[int, int]] = (),
) -> int:
    """Compute the EpochTick at which an enqueued job breaches ``policy``.

    The enqueue timestamp is an absolute wall time (leap offsets apply); the
    budget is a relative duration (ceiling ticks, no offsets) plus
    ``grace_ticks``. ``blackout_windows`` are half-open ``[start, end)`` ranges
    in EpochTick coordinates that do not consume budget. The breach tick is
    never inside a blackout. Runs in O(w log w) regardless of budget size.

    remaining = duration_ms_to_ticks_ceil(policy.budget_ms) + policy.grace_ticks
    for start, end in merge_half_open_windows(blackout_windows):
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start > cursor:
            available = start - cursor
            if remaining < available:
                break
            remaining -= available
        cursor = end
    return cursor + remaining
